title: Harry Reid's special access program request denied by William Lynn

tellings.quote: mean, Harry Reid tried to get a special access program and he failed because Deputy Secretary of Defense William Lynn denied it.

plain: Around 2009, Senator Harry Reid tried to get the Pentagon's UFO work made a special access program, a classified project that only a short list of cleared people may know about. He failed because Deputy Secretary of Defense William Lynn turned him down, according to a physicist named Eric W. Davis. Davis tells it on Michels's show to show that even a powerful senator could not win that level of protection for the effort.
